description.value:
Your eidolon is surrounded by an aura of hope in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]. It has the aura and divine traits. Whenever your eidolon becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, reduce the condition value by 1 (to a minimum of 0). At the end of your turn, each ally in the eidolon's aura reduces its frightened value by 1. Allies within your eidolon's aura gain a +2 status bonus to saves against fear and unholy effects and are immune to the effects of your eidolon's Radiant Wings.

Allies in the aura receive @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-sovereign.summons-unleashed.Item.sGiACqCE3eCa9qW7]{Effect: Serpent Hope} automatically.
